name: Command Code
short: Subscription coding-agent plus an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible Provider API that bills models at upstream rates with no markup.

plans.name: Go
plans.notes: 60 of 98 models; $6–$10 per-model credits in one shared pool; $3/5h, $6/week, $10/month caps; no API access.

plans.name: GOAT
plans.notes: ~75K requests, full API access, and free Laguna S 2.1, Glyph Cluster, Beam 1.0 and TypeSafe Jev.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Open-source plus premium models; Max 10x is $100/month ($150 credits) and Max 20x is $200/month ($300 credits).

plans.name: Provider API
plans.notes: OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoints, no markup; top-ups roll over and never expire.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: ~35K requests, one shared bucket with pooled usage and central admin; Enterprise is custom.
